answer: A ballot is issued only to the agent that holds exclusive title to one wave-rider buoy moored in a named reef pass, enrolled by two unaffiliated tenders that record the hull ID, GPS watch circle, and a pressure-spectrum kernel unique to that channel's swell. Mid-epoch the registry names a slack-water minute; both tenders must re-read the same spectrum within a tight residual and enter a signed quill against the buoy's coordinates and hull stamp. A harbor mockup, a recorded swell, or many keys sharing one buoy miss that live residual and forfeit the bond. One real mooring supports one vote.
